issues.evidence: antibody_corr 0.844 (antibody_corr_z -23.86) versus 0.960-0.971 for the other 11 channels. pc1_z_within_antibody 18.922 (next largest absolute value 2.579), pc2 -23.219 while all other channels lie between -4.654 and 7.871, and pc1 19.972 versus 9.991-11.163 for the other IgG channels. Its paired ratio in culture DMSO_3 has ratio_iqr 1.348 versus 0.538-0.602 in the other five cultures, and median_ratio -0.008 versus -0.127 to -0.173. Loading is unremarkable (raw_median 20.011, raw_median_z -0.667), and n_quantified is 1436 (others 1456-1473), so this is not a low-loading problem.
issues.impact: The within-culture contrast EZH2_vs_IgG_in_DMSO is affected because DMSO_3 contributes a noisy, shifted EZH2/IgG ratio, with roughly twice the spread of the other cultures. The within-culture interaction is affected because it uses this DMSO ratio, so it gains noise and possible bias. The between-culture contrast CPI169_vs_DMSO_in_IgG is affected because this sample is one of only three DMSO IgG replicates. Its variance will be inflated and its mean shifted for proteins that respond to whatever is different in this sample. CPI169_vs_DMSO_in_EZH2 and EZH2_vs_IgG_in_CPI169 are not directly affected. The DMSO_3 median ratio is about 0.16 log2 higher (less negative) than the other cultures. If this reflects a global offset, it would raise the mean DMSO EZH2-vs-IgG ratio and bias the interaction (CPI169 minus DMSO) slightly downward. The per-protein direction cannot be determined from these metrics. slope_vs_other_cultures is 0.96, in line with the other cultures (0.865-0.900), so the culture's ratios still follow the common pattern with extra variation superimposed.
issues.recommendation: Do not use R3_DMSO_IgG unchanged in the primary analysis. Run the analysis with and without it, or down-weight it, and report both results. If it is excluded, the DMSO IgG group has n=2 and the DMSO_3 EZH2 sample loses its pairing. In that case use a model that tolerates the missing pair, and interpret the interaction cautiously. To find the cause, check whether this IgG channel's enriched-protein profile resembles the EZH2 channels or a bead/background profile, inspect the proteins that drive PC2, and review the sample-handling records. These checks would distinguish a pull-down or labelling failure from contamination or mislabelling.

summary: Eleven of twelve channels are consistent. EZH2 and IgG separate cleanly on PC1 (antibody association 0.98), and compound is separated on PC3 (0.861). The EZH2-vs-IgG loading difference of about 0.2 log2 is the same in both treatments, and compound loading is almost equal (DMSO 20.095, CPI-169 20.144), so loading is not confounded with treatment. The exception is R3_DMSO_IgG, a strong outlier on antibody_corr, PC1 and PC2, which doubles the spread of the DMSO_3 paired ratio. It weakens the DMSO within-culture contrast, the interaction, and the between-culture IgG contrast. A sensitivity analysis without it, plus the checks above, is recommended.
